proves: The 0x12 reply is 48 bytes, echoes 0x12, reports result 0x00, and carries a 32-character uppercase-hex identifier at bytes 4..35 followed by six zero bytes. The identifier is redacted here; its length and alphabet are pinned, its value is not.

request.checksumAlgorithm: LE16 sum of bytes 0..45 inclusive (HIDC included)

response.checksum: device-specific: sum of bytes 0..45 includes the identifier, so the expected checksum cannot be published. The capture verified it matches the device's own reply.

notes: A 64-byte read buffer was supplied; the device transferred exactly 48 bytes. No 64-byte response has ever been observed.
Twice-captured (01-info.json and 01b-info.json) with identical prefix, length, result code and body shape; the identifier was identical, the value is not recorded.
